title: Luxuriant
summary: LUXU'RIANT, adjective 1. Exuberant in growth; abundant; as a luxuriant growth of grass. 2. Exuberant in plenty; superfluous in abundance. Prune the luxuriant the uncouth refine. 3. A luxuriant flower

inlines.v: LUXU'RIANT, adjective 1. Exuberant in growth; abundant; as a luxuriant growth of grass. 2. Exuberant in plenty; superfluous in abundance. Prune the luxuriant the uncouth refine. 3. A luxuriant flower multiplies the covers of the fructification so as to destroy the essential parts.
